subject.title: fix: prevent exec approval revocation races

question: After the correctness defects are repaired, should unverifiable ownership make the shipped general plugin file-lock API fail closed, or should that behavior remain scoped to exec approvals?
rationale: This changes an existing plugin SDK availability and recovery contract; source review cannot choose the permanent security-versus-availability boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Keep fail-closed with recovery contract
options.body: Retain the general fail-closed behavior, document operator recovery, and add exact-head plugin compatibility and recovery proof.

options.title: Scope fail-closed to approvals
options.body: Use strict locking for exec approvals while preserving the shipped recovery behavior for unrelated plugin locks.

options.title: Split the lock change
options.body: Land the approval transaction repair separately and defer the public plugin-lock contract to a focused owner-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed with recovery contract
recommendation.body: Retain the general fail-closed behavior, document operator recovery, and add exact-head plugin compatibility and recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced both the exec approvals flow and the shared plugin file-lock surface and has the strongest relevant merged history.
